limitations: Single-worker in-process execution; startup recovery requires task ownership/leases before multi-worker deployment.
Cooperative cancellation cannot revoke already dispatched model requests or forcibly interrupt synchronous CPU computation.
Rerun retains resolved questions/parameters and suite metadata, but uses current repository knowledge and model settings; no complete environment replay.
Legacy auto-smoke reruns explicitly regenerate questions when original inputs were not saved.
